Photography is a mix of promo graphics and only a handful of real, large-enough shots, so facts still lead but the rhythm underneath is an even, generous stacked flow rather than the tense ledger the last firm used — services and reviews get pulled forward since

published.about: At Snellings Law, we maintain a humble confidence in everything we do. We know our strengths and weaknesses and we are confident in our choices. We learn from our mistakes, and always put our clients first.

blocks.heading: We Know The Fear and The Stress
blocks.text: In the moments after an accident caused by someone else’s negligence, we all first look to make certain we and our loved ones do not have any life-threatening injuries. If we can see that is the case, then there is usually an overwhelming sense of relief. However, that relief is often short-lived. It doesn’t take long for at-fault drivers or parties to begin shifting blame, insurance companies to start trying to put words in our mouths or minimize our injuries, and bills to start showing up in the mailbox.

blocks.heading: Our Mission is to Help You Recover
blocks.text: If you or a loved one has been injured in an accident due to someone else’s negligence, you most likely have several questions or concerns. You’ve come to the right place. At Snellings Law, personal injury is all we do, and we’re the car accident lawyer Frisco, TX residents can count on.

blocks.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
blocks.text: Got questions about personal injury? We’ve got you covered! At Snellings Law, we’re always here to answer any questions related to your case. What qualifies as an injury? In personal injury law, an “injury” means any harm or damage to your body (or even your mind/emotions) caused by someone else’s actions or negligence. It’s not limited to obvious wounds like broken bones or cuts – it includes a wide range of harm. For example, injuries can be physical (sprains, fractures, head trauma, etc.) as well as financial and emotional. If you had to get medical treatment, missed work, or experienced pain and suffering because of an incident, those all qualify as injuries in the eyes of the law. Essentially, if you were hurt or incurred losses due to another party’s carelessness or wrongful act, it counts as an “injury” for a personal injury claim. testimonials.author: Doug Sharp
testimonials.text: My son was in a car accident and he received a letter from his insurance company that was unsettling and difficult to understand. I reached out to Scott Snellings to see if he would be willing to help and within minutes, Scott responded and began helping me, even though he was heading into a meeting. Soon after, Scott responded with sage wisdom regarding how to proceed and caring words to comfort our collective anxiety. Scott is an experienced and discerning attorney, but even more importantly, he is a kind and caring man with solid Christian character, who is willing to help others. I highly recommend Scott and Snellings Law.

testimonials.author: Ryan Gibson
testimonials.text:
We recently wrapped up a case with Snelling Law Firm after being hit by a distracted driver running a red light. Unfortunately, their insurance company didn’t come close to offering a fair settlement or taking care of us on our totaled vehicle, which left us with no real choice but to seek help.

From day one, Snelling Law Firm was outstanding. The care team and doctors they connected us with were incredible—professional, attentive, and genuinely focused on getting us back to full health. That alone made a huge difference.

On the legal side, their team was just as impressive. They handled everything with confidence and clarity, kept us informed throughout the process, and ultimately secured a settlement far beyond anything expected. We didn’t go into this looking for some big payout.  We simply wanted to be treated fairly. Thanks to Snelling Law, we ended up more than whole.

We are incredibly grateful for Scott Snellings and the entire team. If you ever find yourself in a similar situation, don’t try to handle it alone. Call them. Highly, highly recommend.

testimonials.author: Katey Miller
testimonials.text: This is the only office you need to consider if you’re looking for friendly, informed, communicative, and transparent representation on your case. I worked with a couple different attorneys at Snellings, and all were not only excellent at their jobs, but very personable to boot. Royeal is the attorney I worked with through the last few months of my case, and she is exactly the person you want on your side when dealing with something like this. Supportive, incredibly knowledgeable, and clearly cares about her clients—I can’t rave enough. Thank you to Royeal and the whole team at Snellings for making a situation most would groan at into an experience that was as stress free and straightforward as possible.

testimonials.author: Jennifer S.
testimonials.text:
I reached out to Ray after an injury situation and, even though my case wasn’t ultimately the right fit for his firm, he still took the time to help me understand my options and point me in the right direction.
He was generous with his time, thoughtful, and gave me practical advice that helped me feel much more informed and in control of the process. What stood out most was that he was honest, kind, and willing to help even when there was no obligation to do so.
Legal situations can feel really overwhelming, and I genuinely appreciated his guidance. I’m very grateful for the time he took to help me.
